guard_streams.authority: Department for Science, Innovation and Technology
guard_streams.write_limit: A statistics work-programme description explains publication scope and revisions but does not verify current selected-parcel coverage or measured speed.

facts.detail: The work update includes a section on BDUK delivery-performance statistics.
It states that quarterly and annual official-statistics publications have reported BDUK delivery since July 2025.
The statistics count UK premises receiving gigabit-capable broadband as a result of BDUK subsidy.
The series includes premises delivered from 2012 onwards.
Earlier delivery is presented in a condensed before-2021 category.
The publications include revised figures for earlier periods.
The quarterly publication provides a brief high-level bulletin supported by data tables.
Quarterly tables cover geography, premises type and intervention type.
The annual publication is described as more comprehensive than the quarterly release.
Annual tables add local-authority, parliamentary-constituency and urban-rural breakdowns.

guard_streams.source: Quality and methodology information for BDUK delivery performance, annual: April 2024 to March 2025
guard_streams.write_limit: The QMI documents source systems, limitations and suitable uses; it does not itself provide current selected-parcel coverage and explicitly warns against misuse.

facts.detail: The QMI explains data-quality characteristics and the methods used to create the statistics.
It is intended to help users understand strengths and limitations of the data.
It helps users decide suitable uses and reduce the risk of misuse.
The statistics report premises receiving gigabit-capable broadband as a result of BDUK subsidy.
BDUK uses Office for National Statistics geographic data.
BDUK uses Northern Ireland Statistics and Research Agency geographic data.
BDUK uses Scottish Government geographic data.
BDUK uses AddressBase Premium in its geographic source stack.
BDUK uses premises- and postcode-level Ofcom data to estimate whether subsidised premises are in Ofcom's premises base.
The methodology states that the most recent available Connected Nations dataset is used.
